name: ai-testcase-system
description: Full-stack AI Test Case Generator and Management System

scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-ports.js && node scripts/clean.js && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
